input.rationale: Section 4 (Term; Termination; Termination Payment) addresses only notice, the Termination Date and the Termination Payment; there is no exit, transition-assistance, data return/export or deletion language anywhere in the Agreement (searches for transition, migration, return, delete/destroy return nothing, and the confidentiality provisions in Section 8 contain no return-or-destroy obligation). In a hosting arrangement where HDI holds our Content, user information and customer data, the absence leaves us with no right to our data or migration help on exit — below the fallback (90 days' assistance plus 30-day export). Proposed new Section 4.3 inserted after the Termination Payment mechanics gives six months' transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, 30-day return in machine-readable format, and deletion with written certification.

proposal.summary: Insert new Section 4.3 requiring HDI to provide up to six months of transition assistance and to return and then certify deletion of Company Content and data on termination.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a wind-down provision because the Agreement is silent on exit: on termination HDI must give us up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, return our Content, user information and other data within thirty days in a machine-readable format, and then delete and certify deletion. We can accept a 90-day assistance period as a fallback.

ops.text: 4.3 Transition Assistance; Return of Company Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) at the Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance, including cooperation in migrating the Site and its operation to the Company or its designee, for a period of up to six (6) months following the Termination Date at HDI's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of the Company's request, return to the Company all Content, user information, customer files, transaction records and other data of the Company in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such Content, user information and data from its systems and certify such deletion to the Company in writing. HDI shall not delete, withhold or render inaccessible any such Content, user information or data prior to completing its obligations under this Section 4.3.
